title: Divergences

fixes.replaceWith: { dataIndex: 12, label: "Candlestick Trigger → Reversal Down", position: "top" }
fixes.reason: Lesson bullet: 'The divergence signal is strongest when it appears at a key S/R zone simultaneously with a candlestick trigger.' The resistance zone is already drawn and the divergence is labelled at index 11, but the candlestick TRIGGER that the lesson says completes the short signal is not named on the chart. Index 12 is the first bar of the reversal leg (to:96), the correct bar for the trigger. Renaming the existing point (rather than adding a colliding new point at the same index) names the 'S/R zone + trigger' confluence the text teaches.

edits.reason: Closes the only genuine gap: the candlestick trigger that, combined with the resistance-zone confluence, completes the bearish-divergence short setup the lesson describes.

notes: REJECTED auditor proposals: (1) introChart markLines LL1=80 / LL2=77 and (2) lessonChart markLines HH1=101 / HH2=106. The level VALUES are correct and inside band, but in both charts the existing S/R markArea already occupies exactly that band (intro support 75-81 contains both 80 and 77; lesson resistance 101-108 contains both 101 and 106), so the reference lines would sit INSIDE the zone fill and clutter it without delivering the intended 'price stepping down/up' visual — and the two extremes are already explicitly labelled as 'LL1'/'LL2 (Lower)' and 'HH1'/'HH2 (Higher)' in the markPoints. Restraint favours not stacking dashed lines inside a same-colour zone. ACCEPTED the auditor's lessonChart candlestick-trigger idea, but routed it as a FIX renaming the existing index-12 point instead of a new markPoint (a new point at index 12 would collide with 'Reversal Down').
